_doc: Mixamo (mixamorig:*) → UE5/GASP mannequin bone rename map. Used by tools/blender-fbx-to-glb.py via --rename-bones. Mixamo skeleton has fewer bones than UE5; mappings here cover the load-bearing biped bones (hips, spine, neck, arms, hands, legs, feet) plus thumb_01/02 and index_01/02 fingers. Unmapped Mixamo bones (e.g. ToeBase, HandThumb3, HandIndex3) keep their mixamorig:* names because UE5 has no equivalent — GASP clip tracks for those targets simply won't bind, which is what we want. Spine fold: Mixamo's 3 spines map to UE5's spine_01 / spine_03 / spine_05 (skipping the in-between bones); GASP clip motion partially applies but reads correctly.
